title: Regression Session
body: Rohan has a set of data points $$x_{i}\in{R}$$ and $$y_{i}\in{R}$$ for $$i\in\{1, ..., n\}, $$ and wants to use regression on inputs $$x_i$$ to predict $$y_i$$ values. He decides to use the following model:\n$$\hat{y}_i=\theta\log(x_i**{2})$$ with $$\theta\in{R}$$
lesson: Loss Functions and Gradient Descent B
